title: Copilot Studio: cost visibility in agent evaluations
summary: Hold: the spending guidance implies that an environment allocation and disabling tenant-pool draw bound all consumption, but Microsoft says pay-as-you-go usage can continue. The allocation request is incomplete, an environment-control path omits a section, and the Monitor page is placed in the wrong portal.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs rather than the individual maker or user.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs, from prepaid capacity or through the environment's pay-as-you-go billing plan, and not to the individual makers or users who run agents.

claims.claim: Generating and creating evaluations consume credits under Microsoft Copilot harness billing.
claims.quote: Experiences such as creating an automated solution with natural language, previewing and testing an agent, and generating and creating agent evaluations all consume credits.

claims.claim: An API equivalent for viewing the displayed evaluation credit estimates is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio evaluation results credits API Dataverse botcomponent testset evaluation Power Platform CLI; Dataverse evaluation credits Copilot Studio. Read Bots - Get Maker Evaluation Test Run and pac get-maker-evaluation-test-run; no credit fields documented.

claims.claim: The environment-control path is Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.
claims.quote:
In the navigation pane, select Licensing.
Under Products, select Copilot Studio.
Select Manage Copilot Credits.
claims.fix: Insert the documented Products section: 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant', in front matter and the table. Qualify the row: 'A published environment-group rule makes this setting read-only; change the group rule or remove the environment from the group to manage it independently.'

claims.claim: The printed PUT request with entitlementId MCSMessages and a TenantPool enforcement rule is a complete allocation call.
claims.fix: The endpoint, PUT method and API version are real; the pre-check's literal-URL miss is not evidence otherwise. Replace the incomplete call in both places with 'PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01; Content-Type: application/json; body: {"scope":{"environmentId":"<environment ID>"},"allocatedEntitlements":[{"entitlementId":"MCSMessages","allocation":{"quantity":<credits>},"enforcementRules":[{"ruleType":"TenantPool","enabled":false}]}]}'. Use an authenticated Power Platform API request. Add to the row note: 'A published environment-group rule prevents individual TenantPool updates; requests are rejected with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.'

claims.claim: The agent-limit path is Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit.
claims.quote:
1. In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio.
2. Select Manage Agents.
3. Select the agent, and then select Set limit.

claims.claim: An automation call for the monthly agent limit and Stop usage is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Platform API agent monthly consumption limit Stop usage Copilot Credits PowerShell pac admin; Copilot agent monthly limit pac; PowerShell agent monthly limit. Read capacity and harness-cost pages and governance search excerpts; no setter call documented.

claims.claim: Managing capacity requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or an equivalent licensing-and-capacity role.
claims.quote: To manage Copilot Studio capacity, you need the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: Capacity and consumption controls are shared across Copilot Studio, rather than exclusive to these evaluations or this harness.
claims.quote: The capacity and consumption controls in the Power Platform admin center apply across Copilot Studio. They aren't exclusive to the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.claim: Agent limits are not instantaneous and an agent can keep responding after reaching one.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Caps; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: An allocation, the tenant-capacity draw option and an agent monthly limit bound evaluation spending without further qualification.
claims.quote:
An allocation isn't a boundary if the environment can continue drawing from tenant capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.
This setting doesn't prevent consumption through a pay-as-you-go billing plan linked to the environment.
claims.fix: Replace the Caps opening with: 'An allocation with Draw from the available capacity in my tenant cleared bounds prepaid consumption, but usage can continue through a linked pay-as-you-go billing plan. An agent monthly limit with Stop usage stops the agent, not the agent flows it calls; those are billed and checked separately.' In Before rollout, replace 'so evaluation credits are bounded' with 'to bound prepaid consumption; this does not stop usage through a linked pay-as-you-go billing plan'. In Autonomy & actions, replace 'and the environment allocation' with 'and, for prepaid consumption with no enabled overage source, the environment allocation'. The agent-flow qualification is stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/manage-copilot-studio-copilot-credits-capacity.

claims.where: controls[2].governs; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: An agent can have a monthly Copilot Credit limit, notification threshold and optional Stop usage action.
claims.quote:
Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit.
Configure the notification threshold.
Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: Changing shared capacity can affect other agents, workflows and features in the same environment.
claims.quote: Changes to shared capacity can affect other Copilot Studio agents, workflows, and features in the same environment.

claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center agent inventory has a Harness column for identifying these agents.
claims.quote: The fastest way to identify these agents is the Harness column in the agent inventory.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises reviewing environment and agent consumption together.
claims.quote: Review environment and agent consumption together. A tenant-level total alone might not reveal an individual environment or agent that is consuming more credits than expected.

claims.claim: Consumption reports are available in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Administrators can view capacity and consumption data at the environment and agent level, and can download consumption reports by environment, agent, or user.

claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center offers the agent's Monitor page.
claims.quote: The agent's Monitor page in Copilot Studio shows the agent's billed credits over time.
claims.fix: Replace 'The Power Platform admin center also offers consumption reports and the agent's Monitor page' with 'The Power Platform admin center offers consumption reports, while the agent's Monitor page is in Copilot Studio'. Retain the existing Learn link.
